finsights.brief: Has raised its dividend for 4 consecutive years

summary: Saudi Awwal Bank posted H1 2026 net income of 4.4B riyals, up 4% YoY; Q2 EPS of 0.9163 missed forecast by 1.36% at 0.9289
Loan growth accelerated to 13% YoY, exceeding full-year target; fee income surged 40% QoQ driven by trade fees and credit card efficiencies
Net interest margin held steady at 2.53% in Q2; management maintained full-year NIM guidance of 2.5%-2.6% and loan growth target above 10%
Cost efficiency ratio of 30.4% exceeded target of below 29.5%; management expects H2 costs flat or lower as tech upgrade spending moderates
Stock traded down 1.86% to $32.76 after initial pre-market gain; CET1 ratio at 14.2% as bank focuses on capital optimization and repricing efforts
